title: Settings
subtitle: Sign-in, assistant, object storage, and SCIM. Secrets stay in the environment.

env.title: Environment
env.subtitle: These values come from process env. They are not edited in the console.
env.s3State: {ready, select, true {S3 credentials present} other {Not configured}}
env.oidcState: {ready, select, true {OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET is set} other {Not configured}}
env.smtpState: {ready, select, true {SMTP_URL is set} other {Not configured}}
env.hint: Secrets come from the environment: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID, S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET, and SMTP_URL.

s3.title: Object storage
s3.subtitle: Files, batch outputs, videos, and optional log archives go to S3 when a bucket and keys are set.
s3.field: {field, select, bucket {Bucket} region {Region} endpoint {Endpoint} prefix {Key prefix} public_base_url {Public base URL} addressing {Addressing} other {Setting}}
s3.domainBucket: The host is the bucket (CNAME or domain bucket)
s3.keysHint: Access keys stay in the environment as S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.subtitle: Your identity provider creates, updates, and blocks console users through SCIM. The token can assign every built-in role, including admin.
scim.issueDescription: {set, select, true {Confirm with your authenticator. The current token stops working immediately.} other {Confirm with your authenticator. The token is shown only once.}}
scim.revokeDescription: Confirm with your authenticator. SCIM requests fail until you create a new token.
scim.tokenHint: It is shown only once. Paste it into your identity provider as the bearer token.
scim.manageHint: Only people who hold every permission can create or revoke the SCIM token.

access.title: Sign-in
access.subtitle: The owner always signs in with a password and two-factor authentication, independent of SSO.
access.registrationHint: Off by default. New accounts get the Viewer role and must set up two-factor authentication. SSO creates accounts on first sign-in regardless of this setting.

sso.redirectHint: Leave empty to use the default callback shown as placeholder.
sso.secretHint: {ready, select, true {OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET is set. The provider must confirm email addresses (email_verified).} other {Set OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment before enabling SSO.}}

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: The console assistant runs on one of your gateway models and is billed like any other request.
assistant.lockHint: {state, select, missing {Pick a default model first.} other {Nobody can switch the assistant to another model.}}
assistant.toolsHint: Which tools the assistant may use is set per role under <link>Roles</link>.
